final_message:
Configured the DNS hierarchy with pc1–pc31 serving the zones shown, pc32 as the recursive resolver, and pc33–pc40 as clients. Created the BIND configurations and zone files, updated startup files, and changed the DNS servers’ images in [lab.conf](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-4p3okqbi/lab/lab.conf) to `kathara/bind`.

Assumed `www.example.com` should point to pc6 because no web-service address was specified. Static checks found matching NS records and glue for all 30 delegations. BIND validation tools were unavailable, and the lab was not run, so live resolution remains unverified.
